evals.name: roastery-schema-and-stats
evals.prompt: Our ops team at Copper Kettle Roasters wants a visual way to watch the business instead of staring at dashboards. I've attached our postgres schema (roastery_schema.sql) and this morning's stats snapshot (roastery_stats.txt). Can you build one of those sim-city style digital twin things — a single html file I can just open in a browser? Want to see orders flowing, the roast pipeline, our warehouses, and it should flag stuff that's stuck or below reorder.
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML with daylight 3D city: region towers sized by revenue, roast pipeline stages, inventory tanks (COL-HUIL and DECAF-SW flagged low), order flow vehicles, slow-ship + South-revenue findings
assertions: Single self-contained HTML, no external network references (CDN scripts/styles/images)
Loads in a browser with zero JavaScript errors
Renders a bright daylight 3D scene (screenshot mean luminance > 0.45, non-blank)
Grounded: contains >=3 real entity names from the input (Coastal, COL-HUIL, DECAF, roast, South...)
Alerts derived from data visible (reorder / pending / SLA / down / stuck)

evals.name: saas-helpdesk-schema
evals.prompt: we run a b2b helpdesk saas called deskly. attached our schema with some current numbers in the comments (deskly_schema.sql). want an interactive 3d city view of the business — accounts, agents, ticket queues — cartoony daylight style like cities skylines. one self-contained html file please, no server stuff
evals.expected_output: Single HTML twin mapping a non-physical business: account towers by MRR, ticket queue buildings in pipeline order, ticket vans flowing, SLA-breach finding on triage, growing waiting_customer flagged
assertions: Single self-contained HTML, no external network references (CDN scripts/styles/images)
Loads in a browser with zero JavaScript errors
Renders a bright daylight 3D scene (screenshot mean luminance > 0.45, non-blank)
Grounded: contains >=3 real entity names from the input (Globex, Initech, triage, waiting_customer...)
Alerts derived from data visible (SLA / breach / waiting / growing)

evals.name: sqlite-real-data
evals.prompt: here's our ops.db sqlite file from the factory. make me a digital twin city visualization of what's in it — single html i can open. would love to actually see where things pile up / get stuck.
evals.expected_output: Single HTML twin built from real queried data: customer towers by ytd_revenue, production line stages by wip, SKU tanks (CTRL-2 below reorder), pending>4d orders as a stuck cluster finding
assertions: Single self-contained HTML, no external network references (CDN scripts/styles/images)
Loads in a browser with zero JavaScript errors
Renders a bright daylight 3D scene (screenshot mean luminance > 0.45, non-blank)
Grounded: contains >=3 real entity names queried from ops.db (CTRL-2, Fabrikam, Welding, Assembly...)
Alerts derived from data visible (reorder / pending / stuck / below)
